T05 Moteur audio useAudioClip: hook client encapsulant HTMLAudioElement unique (useRef, preload="auto"), API { play(stageSeconds), pause(), seek0(), setVolume(0-1), isPlaying, currentTime, error, isIOS }. Impl: audio.src=preview_url → await canplay/loadedmetadata Promise (addEventListener, timeout 5000ms, readyState>=3 fast-path) → audio.currentTime=0 → audio.play().catch(map NotAllowed/Abort → AUDIO_ERRORS.playBlocked/playAborted) → setTimeout primary (stage*1000) + requestAnimationFrame loop + setInterval(20ms) guard (if currentTime>=stageSeconds → pause+currentTime=0). Cleanup: pause+clearTimeout+cancelAnimationFrame+clearInterval+removeEventListener + audio.src='';audio.load() unmount, preview_url change reset. onError → AUDIO_ERRORS.previewUnavailable="Extrait indisponible, nouveau morceau". Volume clamp 0-1 via clampVolume (NaN→0), persist window.localStorage songspot-fr:prefs.volume, iOS détection isIOS(userAgent?) + isVolumeSliderDisabled → slider disabled + tooltip "Volume via boutons matériels sur iOS". Tests 15 (4 helpers purs + 11 smoke) vi.useFakeTimers + mock rAF + MockAudio readyState 4, play(0.1) 110ms→isPlaying false, play(15) 15000ms, double play clearTimeout+cancelAnimationFrame, pause clear, setVolume clamp, preview_url reset, NotAllowedError catch "Lecture bloquée", error event previewUnavailable, seek0, volume persist.
